title: C2 Selection JSON
description: Development/test record for one actual user-selected final cut. Selling points describe product reasons only, while content_blocks records this plan's open, dynamic section order and roles keep promotion separate. Routine SRT execution never calls this JSON schema or Python tools. Create one independent record for each user-selected opening.

verification_mode.description: script means the optional helper was run; manual never claims a machine pass.

selected_ids.description: Source cue IDs for one generated final plan, ordered for playback. Create one selection record per emitted plan.

plan_core.description: The independent, source-supported purchase core that distinguishes this plan from other emitted plans.

estimated_duration_seconds.description: Approximate duration for this cut, planned before drafting after full point-pool review and purchase-information-unit competition. Divide accumulated selected source duration by 1.2. The target is 90 seconds, with 90–95 preferred, 95–100 reviewed, and over 100 triggering special optimization, all measured before display rounding. Necessary irreplaceable content may exceed 100 seconds with evidence-backed reasons; do not truncate automatically.

full_clip_playback_speed.description: Fixed 1.2x playback speed for the whole-cut estimate and the opening attention reference.

review_reason.description: Explain the per-cut capacity review and how all unique purchase reasons, necessary evidence, conditions, and transitions were protected.

duration_review.description: From 95 through 100 playback seconds, record stage review_95_to_100. Above 100 seconds, record stage special_optimization_over_100 and the special optimization reasoning, even when retaining every board. If lower-value complete boards are omitted, list every board, its source cues, points, and individual reason.

name.description: Open-ended board name based on this product and cut. Do not use a fixed category list.

content_blocks.description: Boards are ordered as whole units. Cue order within each board can change. The flattened cue_ids must exactly match selected_ids, so boards cannot be crossed or interleaved. Put all applicable compliant promotion cues in the last board.

selling_points.description: The complete valid independent purchase-information pool for this product. Promotion is excluded from this pool and every support, evidence, and condition reference. Each plan first covers every valid point and then follows its individual duration review.

role.description: Promotion is a separate role and is never a selling point or support cue. Applicable compliant source wording remains complete in the last board and receives the same prohibited-claim review as other source text.

enum: 种草/推荐/购买信心强化型

transaction_info.description: A verified current-SKU list price may be retained in body text under the existing rule. Closing promotion contains no price or dynamic transaction information.

hard_rule_outcomes.description: AI-recorded hard-rule conclusions for semantic replay comparison; the diff utility reports changes but does not judge them.

opening_choice.description: Optional record of the exact real opening selected by the user, including its necessary immediate bridge. Candidate qualification uses the open-ended viewing-motivation priority: show every distinct qualified first-priority candidate when any exist; otherwise use qualified fallback candidates. This priority defines the candidate pool and does not rank a winner or select for the user. Candidate display has no count limit; the user may select up to three, and each selected opening starts its own independent complete cut. Classify by actual viewing motivation, not product-benefit category or type label. No fixed order, weight, or score within the first priority. At 1.2x, 2.4 and 6 cumulative source seconds are references only, never hard cuts. This schema is not a workflow dependency.

known_unaccelerated_ms.description: Legacy annotation accepted for compatibility. It does not contribute to the whole-cut estimate.
